svg.text: The repair store — data/wm-repair-obligations/ as it is on disk: nine subdirectories, what writes each, and what 'open' means in code

The finding file is the only record of the obligation; its status never changes. Openness is a JOIN: a finding is open when neither resolutions/ nor dismissals/ holds a file of its id (repair_obligation.clj:914-938).
The runner reads the store through that one function at the :stop-line-memory phase (full_loop_runner.clj:4491-4493); 15 of these files are tracked in git, the rest are on disk only (git ls-files).
(a) the nine subdirectories: file counts, and the function that writes each (line numbers at futon2 792ebc37)

findings/ 129 record-system-failure! (repair_obligation.clj:546-593) / record-review-failure! (:501); write-new-or-identical! — the finding is immutable, its :repair/status is written :open and never rewritten
implementations/ 59 record-implementation! (:1661): a reviewed, grounded repair commit; :repair/status :awaiting-validation — 'This does not clear the line'
resolutions/ 68 resolve! (:1764-1823), successor-resolution! (:1840), supersede! (:1737-1762): the record that makes a finding not-open
dismissals/ 26 eight dismiss-*! routes (:944 :980 :1021 :1087 :1164 :1251 :1372 :1513): operator-authored dispositions; also make a finding not-open
verifications/ 8 record-historical-verification! (:745): historical admissions; read by verified-admissions (:847) → :awaiting-validation
verification-evidence/ 8 :wm/historical-repair-verification-v1 evidence the verifications/ admissions pin
discharge-operations/ 9 record-discharge-operation! (:1631-1647): content-addressed :intent / :outcome records of the runner's finalize-run! (repair_discharge.clj:196-217)
ticket-links/ 9 finding-ticket/publish! (finding_ticket.clj:93-131): {:finding/id :finding/ticket {:id :path :finding-sha256 …}} written when the T- ticket is published
occurrence-evidence/ 29 dirs, 29 files occurrence-evidence! (:461): one :wm/repair-occurrence-observation-v1 per observation of a repair-occ finding
(b) the findings, by class and by what the other subdirectories say about them
every finding file's own :repair/status: :open 129 (write-new-or-identical! :312 — the file never changes after it is written)
:repair/class on the 129 finding files: :environmental-hold 24, :incomplete-recoverable 1, :independent-review-failure 16, :machine-failure 86, :system-actuation-failure 2
:repair/schema-version: 1 13, 2 5, 3 111 :repair/occurrence present on 29 (the repair-occ-* family)
what open-obligations (repair_obligation.clj:914-938) computes: every findings/ record whose :repair/id has NO resolutions/ record and NO dismissals/ record;
:repair/status is rewritten to :awaiting-validation when verifications/ (:931-933) or implementations/ (:934-937) names the id; :system-actuation-failure is read as :machine-failure (:925-927);
sorted by :opened-at. obligation-history (:886-912) is the audit view: the same joins, attached to the finding, plus dismissals' own :repair/status.

(c) NOT A RECORD VALUE — open-obligations run here, on the store as it is at generation time
repair/open-obligations called in this process on the store as it is now: 35 obligations;
by :repair/class as reported: :environmental-hold 15, :independent-review-failure 3, :machine-failure 17
by :repair/status as reported: :awaiting-validation 13, :open 22
the id set equals findings − resolutions − dismissals computed here: true
(d) the other subdirectories: statuses, and which records carry a :repair/discharge-context (the key the publication receipt needs, section 4)
resolutions/ 68: :repair/status :resolved 68; with :repair/discharge-context 0 of 68; with :successor-relation 7; :schema nil 67, :wm/historical-repair-resolution-v2 1
implementations/ 59: :repair/status :awaiting-validation 59; with :repair/discharge-context 0 of 59; with :grounded-review-evidence 15

:close :closed-at from 2026-09-23T02:55:44 to 2026-09-23T21:44:04; :close :grounded? false 6, true 3; file name = sha256 of the record's pr-str (:1640-1642), equal to the raw file sha on all: true

Evidence only: counts and frequencies are over the files read; the derived statuses apply the cited function's rule to the files, not a stored field.
